We're excited to be launching a new weekly series for children & families\u2014Open Craft Studio! Join us every Wednesday for open crafting time, perfect for all ages.<\/p>


<\/p>

We will have a different featured craft each week, complete with instructions and supplies to make that craft. Not into that week's craft? No problem\u2014we'll also have an abundance of craft supplies available for your kids to craft whatever their hearts desire.<\/p>


<\/p>

This Week's Craft: Halloween jewelry. We'll have beads in Halloween colors (orange, black, purple, etc) and Halloween charms. Limit four charms per person.<\/p>


<\/p>

Just $10 per participant. You can pay to join in the fun, or use the time while they are distracted to work on your own craft project (or catch up on emails).<\/p>


<\/p>

Important: <\/strong>This is NOT a guided or facilitated workshop or class. This is open crafting time, without an instructor. Each week, we will feature a different craft and will provide the supplies and instructions for that craft. The instructions will included photos and will be created with children in mind, but kids may need parental assistance while crafting.<\/p>


<\/p>

This is NOT a drop-off event. Unless your children are old enough to come to the store alone, they should not left without parental assistance.<\/p>

Boozy Book Fair: A Totally 90s Throwback<\/strong><\/p>

Your favorite collab event is back! <\/p>


<\/p>

Get ready to relive the best week of elementary school with a grown-up twist. The Boozy Book Fair is a nostalgia-packed night inspired by the Scholastic book fairs of your youth, now with cocktails, crafts, and 90s flair. Join People\u2019s Book and Merry Pin for an evening that channels the spirit of the 90s, complete with bright colors, bold prints, and all the bookish magic you remember. This is a fantastic opportunity to score fun, unique holiday presents!<\/p>


<\/p>

What to Expect:<\/p>

  • Signature Cocktails and Mocktails: <\/strong>Sip on drinks inspired by 90s classics and childhood favorites. Each ticket includes your first drink.<\/li>
  • Bookish Booths: <\/strong>Browse a curated collection of books that includes 90s throwbacks like Goosebumps and The Babysitters Club alongside today\u2019s must-reads.<\/li>
  • Crafting Stations: <\/strong>Get your hands messy with 90s-inspired crafting!<\/li><\/ul>


    <\/p>

    Your $18 ticket includes one cocktail or mocktail, happy hour specials during the event, and full access to all stations and activities.<\/p>


    <\/p>

    So grab your fanny pack and your BFF. Whether you were team Animorphs or all about Sweet Valley High, this is your chance to revisit the magic with cocktails in hand. The Boozy Book Fair is where reading, reminiscing, and 90s pop culture collide.<\/p>


    <\/p>

    Timed entry begins at 5pm and last entry is at 8pm!<\/p>

Put down the needles. Pick up the texture.<\/strong><\/p>


<\/p>

Ever look at your yarn stash and think, "I love you, but I want to do something different with you"<\/em>?<\/p>


<\/p>

Join Merry Pin for an intimate, weekend-long dive into the structural side of fiber art. At the Beyond the Skein retreat, we\u2019re moving past the traditional loops of knitting and crochet to explore the architecture of textiles. Over the course of the weekend, you\u2019ll learn to build, blend, and bind fiber into modern art. Whether you're a seasoned fiber artist or a curious beginner, this retreat is designed to help you see your materials in a whole new light.<\/p>


<\/p>

The Workshops<\/strong><\/p>

1. Intro to Frame Loom Weaving: The Mini Series<\/strong><\/p>

Master the ancient rhythm of warp and weft. We\u2019ll start by warping up small frame looms to create high-texture coasters and decorative squares. You\u2019ll learn the basics of tapestry weaving\u2014plain weave, rya knots (the "shag"), and how to finish a piece so it\u2019s gallery-ready (or coffee-mug ready).<\/p>


<\/p>

2. Fiber Alchemy: Carding Your Scraps<\/strong><\/p>

This is the ultimate sustainable "magic trick." Bring those sandwich bags of tiny yarn scraps you couldn't bear to throw away! We\u2019ll use hand carders to deconstruct old yarn into soft, cloud-like fiber. You\u2019ll learn to blend custom colors and then use a needle-felting technique to transform that recycled "wool" into a 3D sculptural object.<\/p>


<\/p>

3. Wrapped & Knotted: Modern Wall Hangings<\/strong><\/p>

In our final session, we\u2019re ditching the tools entirely and working with our hands. Using dowels, driftwood, and bulky yarns, we\u2019ll explore the art of decorative wrapping and structural knots. You\u2019ll leave with a large-scale, modern wall hanging that plays with gravity, fringe, and form.<\/p>


<\/p>

With only 6 spots available<\/strong>, you\u2019ll get plenty of one-on-one time with instructors and deep-dive conversations with fellow makers. Your Registration Includes:<\/strong><\/p>

  • All-Inclusive Instruction:<\/strong> 3 comprehensive workshops.<\/li>
  • Farm Tour:<\/strong> Engage with the property and animals on this family-owned farm!<\/li>
  • Materials:<\/strong> All materials for the workshops, plus your very own frame loom and needle-felting tools to keep.<\/li>
  • Sustenance:<\/strong> 5 thoughtful meals, from Friday\u2019s welcome dinner through Sunday\u2019s "Show & Tell" breakfast, plus snacks.<\/li>
  • Community Memories:<\/strong> A dedicated space to process your own stash into something new.<\/li><\/ul>


    <\/p>

    Payment plans available through Klarna.<\/p>


    <\/p>

    All materials provided, though bringing your own yarn scraps for the Carding Workshop is highly encouraged! <\/p>


    <\/p>

    Schedule & Travel<\/strong> <\/p>

    The retreat will begin at 5pm on Friday, November 6 and end at 11am on Sunday, November 8, a full schedule will be provided to registrants in advance.
